setter_contract_boundary.safety_rationale: Direct memory writes risk state corruption or crash without official game UI synchronization. All actual game mutations must be executed during human-authorized gameplay windows.

proposed_s1_intervention.implementation_instruction: In NBA2K22 Edit Player menu (or designated REA setter tool under supervision), navigate to Damian Lillard -> Tendencies -> Shot Tendency, decrement value from 95 to 80, save roster/savefile, and confirm REA memory readback reads 80.

s1_phase.condition: Shot Tendency set to 80; Touches Tendency remains 99; all other tactics static

s2_phase.condition: Calendar Sim next >= 10 games under identical season settings
s2_phase.data_extraction: Full WorldData capture with score reconciliation and player box extraction

hypothesis_and_falsification.hypothesis_statement: Under Calendar Sim, a 15-point reduction in Damian Lillard's Shot Tendency (95 -> 80) will lead to a statistically measurable decrease in per-game field goal attempts (mean FGA < 19.88) while maintaining comparable minutes per game (> 34.0 MPG).
falsification_criteria: FALSIFICATION_1: If post-intervention mean FGA over >= 10 games is >= 19.88, the hypothesis that Shot Tendency positively scales simulated FGA volume is refuted.

FALSIFICATION_2: If two-sample Welch's t-test comparing S0 and S2 FGA yields p-value > 0.05, the observed difference cannot be distinguished from random simulation noise, and the effect is deemed inconclusive.

FALSIFICATION_3: If Lillard's average minutes shift by > 3.0 MPG (due to injury, foul trouble, or rotation change), the volume difference is confounded by playing time and cannot be attributed to tendency adjustment.
hypothesis_and_falsification.no_causal_overreach_clause: Observational correlation in simulated outcomes does not imply exclusive mono-causality. NBA2K22 Calendar Sim contains coupled multi-variable interactions including team pace, opposing defensive ratings, coach gameplan, and secondary scorer tendencies.
